flag.name: MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2
flag.scope: initial web chain launch; completion re-entry requires the separate completion flag

completion_flag.name: MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2_COMPLETION
completion_flag.scope: opt-in typed completion re-entry bridge from monitor handoff

web_initial_launch.v2: web/lib/runner-v2/controller.ts -> web/lib/runner-v2/agent-bootstrap-plan.ts validates first-agent/profile context, then typed-plan still delegates PTY startup to lib/chain-runner.sh --start
web_initial_launch.fallback: shell launch when v2 disabled or returns unsupported

completion_reentry.v2: lib/agent-functions.sh -> compiled /opt/mentiko/lib/runner-v2-complete.js when MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2_COMPLETION is enabled
completion_reentry.fallback: shell completion when completion flag is disabled or typed bridge exits unsupported
completion_reentry.reason: completion owns fan-in, fan-out, retries, generation backstop, and event archiving; typed re-entry is opt-in until full branch parity is proven

daemon_watchers.current: chain-runner ensures mentiko-watchdog and mentiko-chain-watcher pty sessions
daemon_watchers.v2: must preserve singleton behavior before replacing shell startup

run_json.write_policy: read-modify-write under lock, temp file, atomic rename
run_json.read_policy: lock-free readers tolerate old or new whole file
run_json.initial_status: pending in shell create-run; web-created runs may already be running or pending

event_file.parser_rule: split on first colon; data may contain more colons

generation_completion_contract.core_generation_handoff: generation-result.json is authoritative; mentiko emit is optional for core generation chains
generation_completion_contract.no_emit_salvage: typed completion must import a compatible generation payload before failing a core generation agent that reached completion without its declared event
generation_completion_contract.import_effect: typed completion executor must include a generation-import effect that invokes the existing mentiko generation import path
generation_completion_contract.prompt_policy: core generation bootstrap instructions must not require mentiko emit as a mandatory final step

monitor_contract.completion: OR-latched explicit AGENT_COMPLETE line or declared emits event match
monitor_contract.stale: stale/idle only drives advisor nudges or diagnostics
forbidden: dead without declared event implies success
monitor diagnostic event counts as handoff success

event_match.event: agent emits field lower-case equals event file event lower-case
event_match.source: event source contains agent id case-insensitive
event_match.run_id: if present in env, event run id must match

watcher_contract.condition_policy: fail closed on rejected shell metacharacters or malformed condition

watchdog_contract.alive_source: live PTY session wins over age/stale checks
watchdog_contract.foreign_scope: never reap sessions from another root/namespace/org
watchdog_contract.run_stop: use shared run lock when available
watchdog_contract.stalled_event: diagnostic run-stalled event is not canonical agent handoff

invariants: do not mutate existing shell runner behavior when MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2 is unset
do not use stale json schemas as the runtime truth
do not collapse watcher/watchdog/scheduler/completion into one implicit state machine
do not fabricate agent success events
do not archive sibling-agent or other-run events
preserve run.json lock interoperability with bash
preserve agent terminal status complete vs run status completed
preserve namespace/org/root scoping for daemon sessions
completion re-entry remains shell fallback-capable until parity tests cover every branch
